rule: Origin is classified by evidence. `unclassified` records are excluded from facts, published evolution and any clinical use until evidence exists. No inference is made silently. `origin_ref` of an event/entity = entry_hash of its register entry.

classes.synthetic_fixture: artificially generated or injected; not a person's data
classes.experimental_capture: real capture from a person during an experimental/manual test; not clinical; identity/consent unrecorded
classes.tool_log_not_patient_data: log of an analysis tool; not data about a participant
